description: Jam-Pod is a distraction-free music player with a joystick-driven, monochrome interface. No feed, no algorithm, just your library. Play local Apple Music, hi-res lossless files (FLAC, WAV, ALAC), Apple Music catalog, and podcasts — all from one screen. Custom and smart playlists, retro color themes, haptic navigation. Your music back, not another feed to scroll.

name: UltraPod
tagline: Turn your old iPhone into a music-first dumbphone
description: UltraPod turns an old iPhone into a music-first dumbphone without abandoning the useful parts of a modern device. Stream with Apple Music, keep HealthKit workouts, reading, camera, and essential local tools, while stripping away social feeds and attention traps. It is a focused daily companion for people who want a digital detox without buying another piece of hardware.

name: Mubert API
tagline: Edit tracks & stems, get consistent music with new engine
description: Meet the new Mubert API. Edit tracks, swap stems, and generate more consistent music with our latest engine. Create tracks up to 2 hours long, stream music in real time, and integrate Mubert into your pipeline in minutes with Skills.

name: SUB/WAVE
tagline: Self-hosted radio with an AI DJ and one shared stream
description: SUB/WAVE turns your music library into a real radio station: one shared stream, an AI DJ that picks tracks, reads idents and takes requests in plain language. Self-hosted, works with local LLMs, MIT licensed. Web, iOS, Android and desktop players.

name: Backbeat Forge
tagline: Turn drum audio into a score you can actually edit
description: Drop in a full mix or an isolated drum stem. Backbeat Forge puts the performance on a five-line drum score you can check against playback and correct by hand. When the chart feels right, export it as a printable PDF or General MIDI file. It all runs locally.

name: gesture.live
tagline: Play live electronic music with your hands using your webcam
description: Play live electronic music with your hands over a webcam. Chords, bass, drums and effects, performed through gestures.

name: PieceKeeper
tagline: Track your music repertoire and practice
description: Never lose track of a piece again. PieceKeeper helps musicians manage their repertoire, run focused practice sessions based on a customized practice schedule, get insights and trends about their practice, and learn music theory through interactive drills and exercises aimed at improving both reading and listening skills.

name: FreqWave EQ
tagline: Customize your web audio with a real-time EQ
description: 8-band Web Audio Equalizer - fixing muddy podcasts, harsh streams and quiet dialogue. Featuring EQ modes and DSP Compression.
topics: Chrome Extensions, Music, GitHub, Edge Extensions

name: Browser FX:
tagline: Transform your web audio with real-time effects
description: Browser FX transforms your web audio experience with real-time professional audio effects. Capture any tab's audio and shape it with studio-style knobs in a sleek dark interface, complete with an audio-reactive cymatic visualizer, and even hands-on control from your MIDI controller.

name: EQK 3.0
tagline: Mac app with dynamic AI Equaliser
description: EQK is the first Mac app with dynamic AI EQ - an equalizer that re-tunes itself per song in real time. Give every app its own EQ, headphone correction, and output device. No virtual drivers - just native macOS audio capture. 10-band parametric Tone Desk, 3,985+ AutoEq headphone profiles, per-app limiter, full signal-chain metering, and a free built-in FLAC player with synced lyrics for the songs that you own. 100% local, no telemetry, no subscription. Tune every app on your Mac.

name: EQK
tagline: Mac app with dynamic AI EQ
description: EQK is the first Mac app with dynamic AI EQ - an equalizer that re-tunes itself per song in real time. Give every app its own EQ, headphone correction, and output device. No virtual drivers - just native macOS audio capture. 10-band parametric Tone Desk, 3,985+ AutoEq headphone profiles, per-app limiter, full signal-chain metering, and a free built-in FLAC player with synced lyrics for the songs that you own. 100% local, no telemetry, no subscription. Tune every app on your Mac.

name: Suno Studio 2.0
tagline: Browser-based generative DAW
description: Suno Studio 2.0 brings MIDI, audio effects, chat, automation and more — you can even design your own plugins and synths.

name: Tunio
tagline: AI Music operations platform for venues
description: Tunio is an AI-powered music autopilot for restaurants, cafés, retail stores, hotels, fitness clubs and salons. Stream licensed royalty-free music, automate daypart scheduling, generate AI announcements, jingles, podcasts, news and weather, host live broadcasts, manage multiple locations, integrate with POS systems, use our API, and keep music playing with offline caching and automatic failover.

name: BAP Studio
tagline: An MPC-style drum machine that runs in a browser tab
description: Make beats in your browser with 16 velocity drum pads, a step sequencer, swing, sampling and WAV export. Free, no download, no signup.

name: Gesture Synth School
tagline: A practice app for learning to play music with your hands.
description: Free guided practice for Gesture Synth. Chord charts, gesture tutorials, and a play-along player for popular songs — learn the hand gestures step by step.

name: ChordViz
tagline: Build your own music visualizer for MIDI & audio
description: The visual workspace for music teachers and creators. Turn live MIDI and audio into chord, notation and audio-reactive visuals then record video, audio or MIDI natively. Stream to OBS, TouchDesigner and Resolume for live performance.

name: Vinyl for Mac
tagline: Turn your Mac into a spinning vinyl player.
description: Vinyl turns your Mac desktop into a beautifully animated record player. It syncs with Spotify and spins every album you're listening to in real time. It quietly lives in the background while you work. $9.99, one-time purchase.

name: Jam-Pod (Android)
tagline: A player for people who keep their own music collection
description: Jam Pod brings the iPod Classic back to Android — real click wheel, monochrome screen, scrolling menus. Plays your own local files and podcasts, not a streaming catalog: FLAC/AIFF support, smart + custom playlists, genre browsing, 5-band EQ, sleep timer with fade, 8 iPod-era themes. One-time purchase, no subscription, no ads, no algorithm. Currently in closed beta — join here to install: [Google Group link]

name: Fedica 2.0
tagline: Publish and grow your profile across social apps
description: For creators who want to succeed when their fans are fragmented across platforms. Know who engages, what they care about, and where they're from, with deep audience segmentation and demographics. Publish tailored posts on 12+ platforms. Connect with engagers from one inbox. 15 years of audience intelligence, built on Tweepsmap's geographic foundation. We put the people back in your analytics.

name: Lettertrace
tagline: Track your AI visibility for free (using your own API keys!)
description: Lettertrace measures how often Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini mention your company. But there's a catch: it's free, developer-first, bring-your-own-key, and open source.

name: Kobbe
tagline: Privacy-friendly web analytics with traffic and revenue.
description: Privacy-friendly and cookie-less analytics for your website. Traffic, pages, sources, revenue and funnels. Private by default. Set up in seconds.

name: Human Behavior
tagline: Product analytics told you what happened. We handle it.
description: Dashboards are where insights go to die. Human Behavior closes the loop: 1) Collect. Our SDK captures your events, errors, and session replays. 2) Understand. AI watches every replay, catching rage clicks, dead buttons, and silent give-ups. 3) Act. Background agents email the customer, update Linear and your CRM, and open PRs with the replay as evidence. 4) Loop. Agents check the results and keep the product improving — on its own. No dashboard to babysit. It all lives in Slack or SMS.

name: YourSitee
tagline: Make your bio link worth clicking
description: YourSitee turns your scattered online presence into one visual page that feels like you, not another list of buttons. Build with 20+ widgets, import your Linktree with AI, and see what people click with built-in analytics. All your links. One place.

name: Poth Labs
tagline: The customer brain for your company
description: Customer knowledge isn't a collection of documents. It's a network of relationships. Poth builds a living model of your customers before answering questions, so Ask Poth can reason across all your company knows instead of summarizing isolated sources. That unlocks questions no single source can answer, from what's driving churn to why customers adopt or abandon features. Every conclusion is grounded in evidence. If the answer isn't there, Poth launches adaptive surveys to collect what's missing.

name: Dashi Metrics
tagline: Visualize your revenue on a 3D globe
description: Watch your business come alive—every visitor and payment mapped in real time on a dynamic 3D globe. Dashi transforms static dashboards into live, geographic visualizations, making global trends and customer activity instantly engaging. Spin, zoom, and interact with your data as it happens. Perfect for SaaS teams and founders who want actionable, visual insights instead of boring charts.

name: DepthData
tagline: The system of record for your company's AI spend.
description: Companies now pay for four or five AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, and more) but can't answer the basics: what are we spending, who's using it, and which seats sit idle? DepthData connects every AI tool into one audit ready view of spend and adoption. What makes it different: every number is labeled by how it's verified, we never read prompts, and we show exactly what each vendor's API can and can't expose. The trusted system of record for your company's AI spend.

name: Yapper Leaderboard
tagline: See the biggest startup yappers on X/Twitter
description: The Yapper Leaderboard ranks Twitter/X's startups and users by how much they yap. The startups with the most impressions climb to the top of the daily leaderboard. See weekly growers to keep your eye on which people and companies are trending upwards! Sign into X to add your company and team to the leaderboard!

name: ZapDigits MCP
tagline: The MCP server for marketing data
description: Connect Claude and ChatGPT to Google Analytics, Search Console, Meta Ads and 30+ marketing data sources.

name: Finamie
tagline: Speak your expenses and get instant spending insights
description: Finamie turns your voice into detailed financial insights, automatically. Log expenses hands-free, track your spending, and understand your money like never before.

name: LnkFlow
tagline: Agentic click tracking that shows what grows your business
description: See which campaigns, channels, and collabs make you money! With reliable, server-side click tracking that counts the visits, ad blockers hide. Turn any URL into a short, branded link tagged by campaign, channel, or creator. Rank creators and platforms by who actually drove clicks, with bots filtered out by default. And it's fully agentic-ready: your AI assistant can create links, tag them, and pull reports in plain language — no dashboard required. Clean links in, clear answers out.

name: Product Analytics for Agents and Users
tagline: Optimize Agent Actions with User Behavior.
description: Kubit helps product engineers optimize AI agents with user behavior. Connect agent traces directly to user activities to see exactly why users re-prompt, drop off, or convert. Then, feed those insights straight into your coding agent to build AI products that actually stick. Start instantly with seamless integrations via OTel, your CDP, or Bring Your Own Warehouse (BYOW).

name: Amami
tagline: Analytics that lives inside your AI assistant
description: I built Amami because switching between Cursor and browser tabs just to check traffic felt broken. It's a privacy-first, cookie-free analytics tool with native MCP support — ask Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor "how's my traffic?" and get real-time answers + optimization tips without leaving your editor. GDPR-compliant out of the box with a <2KB script (20x lighter than GA4). The fastest Google Analytics alternative for developers who ship with AI. TRY IT NOW ！！！

name: Coarena by Coasty
tagline: The arena where agents battle on real-world work
description: Coarena lets AI agents compete on real computer tasks, not synthetic benchmarks. Watch multiple models complete the same workflow side by side, compare speed, accuracy, and reliability, then vote for the winner. Discover which agent actually performs best on everyday work across browsers, apps, and enterprise software.

name: NeuroVidz
tagline: See how a brain reacts to your clip
description: Upload a video or audio clip. In about a minute, NeuroVidz maps how a brain would respond to its picture AND its sound — an engagement score that shows its components, a per-second emotion timeline, and timestamped suggestions for your next edit. Most tools focus on the frames alone; NeuroVidz listens too, so podcasts, music, and voice-driven clips score like a listener feels. If it can't produce a confident read, it refunds the credits. Start free, no card — founding 50 accounts get 40 credits.

name: Reignat
tagline: Privacy-friendly web analytics with realtime AI insights
description: Most analytics tools make you choose: Google Analytics is powerful but bloated, simple alternatives strip away too much. Reignat gives you both. One fast dashboard with visitors, sources, funnels, and full visitor journeys, plus things the others don't have: a realtime 3D globe of your visitors, revenue attribution that shows which pages and channels actually earn, an AI assistant that answers questions about your traffic in plain words, and embeddable widgets for your own site.

name: Growth Opt Playbook
tagline: Turn campaign data into your next marketing move
description: A free, browser-only workspace for performance marketers. Upload a campaign CSV or connect Google Sheets to diagnose performance shifts, budget headroom, creative fatigue, experiments, and marketing response(MMM,Regression Model and Cannibalization check)—without sending raw data to a server.

name: Cloud Halo
tagline: Azure FinOps for MSPs with flat pricing
description: Cloud Halo turns read-only Azure cost data into a managed FinOps workflow for MSPs & consultancies: client workspaces, routed alerts, anomaly detection, a savings ledger, and one-click white-label monthly reports. Flat pricing from £99 - never a % of spend.
topics: Analytics, SaaS, Developer Tools, Vercel Day

name: AI Spend Console by Rippling
tagline: Track your AI spend and connect it to business outcomes
description: AI Spend Console gives Finance and Engineering leaders one place to track AI spend across tools (such as Claude and Cursor) and connect it to business outcomes. Break costs down by vendor, model, or employee, then connect spend to GitHub output data like pull request volume and the # of code revisions. You can get started for free–no Rippling subscription required.

name: Equitybee Benchmark
tagline: Compare your startup equity grant for free.
description: Equitybee Benchmark helps U.S. startup employees understand how their equity grants compare. Explore 9,000+ verified new-hire grants across 2,500+ startups by department, seniority, and company stage. For years, companies have benchmarked the equity they offer. Now you can benchmark yours. -- The benchmark provides market context based on Equitybee's dataset and is intended for informational purposes only. The dataset has not been independently verified. Data presented as is.

name: Basedash Subscriptions
tagline: Subscribe to any dashboard. Delivered on schedule.
description: Subscribe to any Basedash dashboard or chart and get a fresh snapshot delivered on a schedule—straight to your inbox or a Slack channel. Pick the cadence (every Monday at 9am, daily, monthly on the 1st), choose who receives it, and each delivery arrives with up-to-date charts and a link back to the live dashboard. No exporting, no screenshotting, no remembering to share. The Monday metrics email your team wants, without anyone building it. Your dashboards, delivered on schedule.
topics: Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence

name: Basedash Suggestions
tagline: Your AI data analyst, now with ideas of its own.
description: Basedash now suggests the analysis before you ask. It studies your connected data, your past chats, and the dashboards you've built, then generates personalized suggestions — questions worth asking, dashboards worth building, automations worth scheduling. Click one and the work starts. Used ideas are replaced with fresh ones, so the well never runs dry. Every suggestion is generated per person, for growth, finance, and ops alike. No more blank page. Your analyst makes the first move.
topics: Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence

name: Basedash AI Kit
tagline: Ship AI analytics in your product, powered by GPT-5.6
description: Basedash is the AI analytics platform — chat with an AI data analyst, automatic daily insights, automations, and dashboards. Now all of it is available through the API. Power your product's customer-facing analytics with a fully custom UI, or extend your internal BI in ways no tool anticipated. Send a question, stream the answer, render the chart — every query scoped to the right customer. Ranked #1 on BI Bench and powered by GPT-5.6. The AI data analyst, now yours to build on.
topics: Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence, OpenAI Day

name: Basedash Audit Logs
tagline: Every action in your BI tool, on the record.
description: Native audit logs for Basedash — every sign-in, query, and configuration change is on the record, including every query the AI runs, attributed and traceable. Answer who saw what, when with one filter, stream events to your SIEM, set retention to match your policy, and pull the log through the API. Built for security reviews and enterprise rollouts, alongside SSO, SCIM, and RBAC. Your BI tool finally has a memory. Every action, on the record.
topics: Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence

name: Trend Seeker
tagline: Market research and idea validation from 140K+ signals
description: Trend Seeker turns recurring demand from Reddit, job ads, podcasts, Google Trends, and product launches into business ideas you can inspect. Each idea shows the problem, source signals, demand trend, competition, opportunity score, and how the cluster changed over time. Browse 7.4K ideas built from 140K+ signals, explore the Demand Map, or validate your own idea against matching user requests. Free to explore, with Pro for full access.
topics: Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence, OpenAI Day

name: valv
tagline: Your database, safe for agents to query
description: Connect Postgres, MySQL, ClickHouse and PostHog once. Scope each role down to the row. Your team's agents work on live data and never see more than you allow.
topics: SaaS, Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, OpenAI Day

name: Tilores Studio desktop entity resolution
tagline: Entity resolution on your machine. No cloud, no signup.
description: Entity resolution has always been enterprise software: book a demo, sign a big contract before you see it run on your data. Tilores Studio changes that. The same real-time matching engine behind our cloud product, running entirely on your machine. Load your CSV, resolve duplicates live, nothing leaves your laptop. Now a local MCP server lets Claude Code, Codex and other AI assistants search, import and steer Studio against your data. Free up to 100k records. macOS, Windows, Linux.

name: Matih
tagline: Plain-English questions, Trusted insights from your data
description: Text-to-SQL tools are schema-blind. they guess the joins and hand you a number you can't check. Matih builds a context graph of your data:-the entities, how tables relate, what each metric means, then reasons over that ontology to answer. Ask in plain English. Matih writes the SQL and auto-routes it to the right engine- DuckDB for a spreadsheet, Spark or Trino for billions of rows- from an Excel file to a full warehouse. You get the answer next to the SQL. Trusted insights, no black box.

name: Sequel
tagline: Connect your marketing stack to Claude, Cursor or Codex
description: Connect marketing, product, and finance data to any AI agent. Sequel learns every metric definition, edge case, and convention from your team.

name: ClariLayer
tagline: AI context layer for analysts
description: ClariLayer is a context layer that connects with any AI you use day to day, so you have durable context about you data, metrics, analysis, etc. The context is durable, cross-sessions and cross-tools, so you will never need to re-explain your data.

name: OtherATC
tagline: Plane spotting made easy for everyone
description: OtherATC helps plane spotters discover curated aircraft collections, track spotting progress, and use airport intelligence to plan their next catch.

name: Dex by Exmergo
tagline: Turn Your Coding Agent into an Analytics Engineer
description: Install it into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI, then point it at your warehouse and dbt project. Dex maps the schema read-only behind a cost guard, authors models and metrics as diffs you review, and tells you what broke when things drift. Also a Python package. npx skills add exmergo/dex
topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics

name: GoodMetrics
tagline: A better alternative to Google Analytics
description: Remember when Google Analytics just worked? We brought that back. Except there are no cookie banners, and you'll actually want to open our dashboard. Most privacy-friendly tools stop at top-line numbers, so digging into what caused them is a chore. We kept first- and last-touch attribution, conversions across sessions, and revenue per event. Then there's the best part. Connect Claude or ChatGPT once and ask your analytics anything. No API key, nothing to install.

name: Bonacci Studio
tagline: Agentic, Visual Data Engineering and Data Science Platform
description: Most AI data tools stop at generating a snippet you still have to run yourself. Bonacci Studio's agent has real tool access: it connects to your database, inspects schemas, writes PySpark or SQL, executes it on Spark, streams logs back, and debugs its own failures. Also included: a visual drag-and-drop DAG builder, Kafka streaming, Apache Camel API integration, RAG knowledge bases, and native MCP support. Bring your own model - Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq, or fully local via Ollama
topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics

name: SEOScan
tagline: On-Page SEO Audit Tool - Complete & Most Comprehensive Data
description: SEOScan shows you why a competitor outranks your page for a specific keyword. Enter your URL, target keyword, and a higher-ranking competitor. SEOScan compares both pages across 400+ factors and combines data from Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz, and Majestic in one report. Launch special: lifetime free plans with the same audit quality and data as paid plans - no gatekeeping. Paid plans add more monthly audits, CSV exports, and password-protected public reports.

name: ADA
tagline: An open-source data analyst that shows its math
description: I tried to automate a data analyst. Contribute to sainesrop in a CSV or Excel file. ADA cleans it, builds a dashboard, flags anomalous periods, projects a guarded forecast, and answers questions about your data. The difference: every chart, every forecast, every chat answer traces back to a pandas calculation you can actually read. Nothing is a black box. Optional AI only ever sees your column schema, never your rows, and the whole product works with no API key. MIT Licensed (want contributors)
topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub, Data & Analytics

name: Remove Excel blank row,even millions row
tagline: Excel Data Cleaner — Remove Millions of Empty Rows Fast
description: Key features: ✅ Remove empty rows at the bottom of Excel files Clean up unused rows that make your worksheet huge or difficult to manage. ✅ Remove blank rows between data Keep your data structure clean without manually selecting rows one by one. ✅ Process large Excel files Designed for large datasets, including files with millions of rows. ✅ Customize blank row rules Define your own conditions to decide which rows should be removed ✅ Fast batch cleaning No repetitive clicking.Done with one-click

name: INFITNITE: Fitness Fantasy RPG
tagline: Your real life powers the game
description: Infitnite is a Fitness Fantasy RPG where your real life powers the game. Unlike fitness apps that add points and badges to tracking, Infitnite turns how you train, eat, think, and connect into the progression of a persistent Avatar shaped by who you are and who you want to become. Complete real-world actions to earn XP, develop skills, advance through quests and Campaigns, and become stronger in the game by becoming stronger in life.
topics: Android, Health & Fitness, RPGs, Fantasy Games

name: Mahabharata
tagline: Mahabharata: Rise of Kingdoms
description: Mahabharata: Rise of Kingdoms is a free browser-based strategy card game inspired by one of India's greatest epics. Recruit legendary heroes, build powerful armies, and progress through increasingly difficult battles where every decision matters. No downloads are required just open your browser and play.
